nom: The INKEY List Hydrating Cream-To-Milk Cleanser with Hyaluronic Acid

segments.oily: A reviewer with oily skin used it cautiously but had no reaction, and another with normal skin that turns oily in summer reports it rinses with no film or oiliness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as non-drying and non-tightening, leaving skin soft rather than 'Sahara desert' dry, though one reviewer felt the hydration fell short of expectations for her very dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it balances oily and dry areas without over-stripping, and one with combination/sensitive/acne-prone skin reports fewer breakouts and more hydrated, glowy skin over time.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with eczema, rosacea or reactive skin who previously relied on prescribed emollients, describe it as gentle, calming and non-irritating with no fragrance-related reactions reported.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin that shifts seasonally found it worked well year-round and suspects even oily types could tolerate it.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (including women in their 50s-80s) report soft, hydrated, non-tight skin and call it a favourite for dehydrated, ageing skin.

concerns.aging: An 82-year-old and a 59-year-old reviewer both report soft, comfortable skin with no irritation; one links continued use to few wrinkles, though this is anecdotal rather than a stated product effect on wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with dehydrated or dry-mature skin report visibly more hydrated, plumped, non-tight skin after use; no dissent noted.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea- or redness-prone skin report calmer, less reactive skin and no flare-ups from this cleanser.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers managing a compromised or reactive barrier (eczema, prescribed-emollient users) report the cleanser is gentle enough to replace harsher options without stripping or tightness.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hormonal acne reports less irritation and visible improvement within a week; another notes continued breakouts from her acne despite overall skin improvement.
concerns.blemishes: A reviewer prone to breakouts after switching from another cleanser reports no new breakouts and no oily residue; another combination/acne-prone reviewer reports reduced breakout frequency.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin and combination reviewers report the cleanser rinses cleanly with no oily film or greasy residue.

extraits.texte: By far the best cleanser I've found on the market. I have dry and sensitive skin but this product is so moisturizing. 5 stars.

extraits.titre: Gentle Hydration in a Tube: A Must-Have for Sensit
extraits.texte: As someone with sensitive skin I'm always cautious about introducing new products but this cleanser has been nothing short of gentle and effective.The texture starts as a creamy consistency and transforms into a milky emulsion upon contact with water making it easy to massage into the skin. It effectively removes daily grime and light makeup without leaving my skin feeling stripped or tight. In fact my skin feels soft and hydrated after each use.One of the standout features is its formulation. The inclusion of ceramides and glycerin helps maintain the skins natural barrier and retain moisture which is a boon for those of us with dry or sensitive skin. Additionally the absence of fragrance and harsh chemicals means it's less likely to cause irritation.While it is excellent for daily cleansing I did notice that it struggles a bit with removing heavy or waterproof makeup. For those occasions I pair it with a dedicated makeup remover.Overall The Inkey List Hydrating Cream-to-Milk Cleanser is a gentle hydrating option that's perfect for daily use especially for those with sensitive skin. It's affordable effective and has earned a permanent spot on my bathroom shelf. Honest review submitted in exchange for product gifted by The INKEY List

i was surprised how much i love this face wash. i have combination, sensitive and acne prone skin. i was a little worried about the hydration aspect breaking me out, but it did the opposite. i started using this around june ish, and have noticed such a big difference in my skin since then. i have less frequent breakouts & my skin feels and looks much more hydrated and glowy. i have been using this in the morning, and at night as a first cleanse (after micellar water & followed by panoxyl)! it is milky but not thick, kind of like a thin lotion consistency. there is no smell / fragrance. the packaging is simple & you get a lot of product in each bottle. 10/10

It leaves my skin feeling so soft after and i find it helpful that the bottle has a pump on it so it's easier to get the recommended amount of product out of it. it hasn't broke me out or left my skin feeling stripped at all like some cleansers i've used in the past have, my skin feels a lot less irritated and like it could flare up at any moment, but which is great considering i have extremely sensitive skin and struggle with hormonal acne. i've only been using this product for a week and i can see an improvement! i would definitely recommend trying this product out for yourselves!

I've been converted to the oat cleansing balm, due to a recent breakout, and this is great as a second cleanser in the evening. Leaves skin hydrated and clean, I absolutely love it. I have sensitive, dehydrated and dry mature skin and all the products I have tried seem to suit my skin really well and I'm so grateful to find a brand that is affordable and works.

I have very sensitive, reactive and eczema prone skin.. so much so that I had been using a prescribed emollient as a facial cleanser for eight months, which was not a pleasant experience but all my skin could handle. To be able to find this cleanser that is so gentle and nourishing to my skin has given me my love of skin care back!
It was not the hydration that I expected. Maybe my skin is very dry
